uutiset.t: Brazil Real Rallies on Reports Lula Backs Further Spending Curbs
uutiset.s: The Brazilian real rallied by the the most in nearly two months after reports that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is backing further moves to curb government spending, easing the concerns about the deficit that dragged the currency down sharply after his surprise re-election last month.

uutiset.t: Venezuela Unveils $237 Billion Debt Load Ahead of Restructuring
uutiset.s: Venezuela’s government said public debt stood at $237.5 billion in 2025, setting the stage for what could be one of the largest sovereign debt restructurings in history.

uutiset.t: Petrobras aumenta investimentos com alta do petróleo
uutiset.s: Mariana Durão fala sobre o novo plano de cinco anos de investimentos da Petrobras, com mais dinheiro na produção e refino do petróleo. Edição de Patrícia Xavier (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Senegal Debt Rework Risks Delay on Budget, Morgan Stanley Says
uutiset.s: Morgan Stanley is skeptical of Senegal completing a debt restructuring by a self-imposed year-end deadline as an impasse over the budget risks stalling the process.

uutiset.t: OPEC+ Faces Its Most Consequential Supply Decision of the Year
uutiset.s: When OPEC+ oil ministers gather at the end of this month to figure out how much crude to supply the world, they’ll face their most consequential decision of the year.

uutiset.t: Shenzhen conquered tech, now it wants culture
uutiset.s: Shenzhen grew rich manufacturing electric cars, drones, and smartphones. Now China’s tech capital is spending billions on building a cultural scene. Backed by tech billionaires like Tencent’s Pony Ma, the city is racing to reinvent itself as a global cultural hub. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Codelco Offers Lower Copper Premiums to Revive Sales to China
uutiset.s: Chile’s state-owned miner Codelco is offering more favorable and flexible commercial terms to Chinese copper buyers as it seeks to rebalance its sales book back toward Asia after selling huge volumes to the US this year.

uutiset.t: EDF Unit Plans €1 Billion Forge as New Nuclear Push Readied
uutiset.s: Electricite de France SA’s Framatome unit is ready to approve an investment of more than €1 billion ($1.1 billion) to build a new forge that will make large parts for nuclear reactors, as it prepares for a wave of atomic plant construction in France and elsewhere.

uutiset.t: Market Timers Get Schooled as S&P 500 Swings Rip Up Playbooks
uutiset.s: Avoiding down days in the stock market often means missing out on the biggest gains. Those who cashed out after US equities reeled last week just learned that lesson the hard way.

uutiset.t: Turkey Frees Ex-Minister Arrested in Fund Scandal After 18 Days
uutiset.s: Turkey released former minister Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya from jail just 18 days after she was arrested in an investment-fund investigation that’s shaken the country’s markets.
World’s top producer of the battery metal says it will ban exports beginning November 30th, in an effort to reverse slumping prices. Bloomberg TV’s Jennifer Zabasajja reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Behind Binance Hack, a Reckoning Over Who Controls Crypto
uutiset.s: As North Korean cyberthieves were funneling billions out of Binance last month, the world’s largest crypto exchange looked to two other companies to help stop the bleeding: Tether and Circle.

uutiset.t: Fund With $21 Billion Favors Africa Local Bonds, Adds to Uganda Bet
uutiset.s: A currency rout that wiped 8% off the value of Uganda’s shilling last month rattled some investors, but failed to deter a $21 billion money manager.

uutiset.t: Arabica Drops as Exchange Stockpiles Surge Most in 28 Years
uutiset.s: Coffee futures fell as supplies in exchange-monitored warehouses posted their biggest daily jump since 1998, offering some relief to a market that has been historically tight.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Sinks Below IPO Price Less Than a Week After Debut
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares plunged below their $83 initial public offering price, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab’s record-setting debut last week.
